item.description: The Flask hook implementation incorrectly passes an 'endpoint' keyword argument to Flask's errorhandler decorator, which is incompatible with newer Flask versions (3.1.2). This causes TypeError when trying to decorate error handlers.
item.contract: Modify the errorhandler_wrapper function in hook_flask to avoid passing the 'endpoint' keyword argument to Flask's errorhandler decorator when it's not supported in the current Flask version.
item.acceptance: Tests tests/test_server_hook_flask.py::test_flask_endpoint, tests/test_server_hook_flask.py::test_flask_endpoint_with_parameters, and tests/test_server_hook_flask.py::test_flask_not_found should pass without TypeError.
